en.bdb: Gurmukh attains the wisdom of understanding

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar eka(n)kaar hoi oa(n)kaar akaar apaaraa|

en.bdb: The formless Lord assuming the form of ekarikcir created myriad names and forms out of Oankar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖਿਓਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕਰੋੜਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom vich rakhion kar brahama(n)dd karoR pasaaraa|

en.bdb: In His each trichome He has kept the expanse of crores of universes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਧੁੰਧੂਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa jug varatiaa agam agochar dhu(n)dhookaaraa|

en.bdb: None knows for how many yugs, ages, there was imperceptible and impenetrable mist.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਜੁਗ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਕੇਤੜਿਆ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa jug varatiaa kar kar ketaRiaa avataaraa|

en.bdb: For many ages continued the activities of many an incarnation (of God).

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਕਲੀਕਾਲ ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vachhal hoi aaiaa kaleekaal paragaT paahaaraa|

en.bdb: The same God, for the sake of his love for the devotees, has appeared in Kalijug (in the form of Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਹੋਆ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: saadhasa(n)gat vasagat hoaa ot pot kar piram piaaraa|

en.bdb: Being like warp and weft and the lover and the beloved one He, controlled by the holy congregation, resides there in.
Only gurmukh possesses the knowledge of that creator Lord.
